# Third-party code

## cubiomes (`vendor/cubiomes/`)

MIT License, Copyright (c) 2020 Cubitect. The full licence is in `vendor/cubiomes/LICENSE`.

Only the parts of cubiomes that JUNO uses are here. The Minecraft 26.x support (`tables/btree215.h`, `tables/btree262.h`, `tables/btree263.h` and the changes to `biomes.h`, `biomes.c` and `biomenoise.c`) comes from the cubiomes fork included with the arb4096 HIP biome scanner, under the same licence.
